name: Quick commands
description: A menu in each Claude terminal's pane header with the slash commands you pick, such as /compact, /clear and /context.
author: Otterm

settings.label: Commands
settings.help: Slash commands for the menu, separated by commas, in the order they show. A command may take words after it, such as /model sonnet.

settings.label: Ask for a second click before /clear and /compact
settings.help: They can't be undone: the first click asks, and a second click within 3 seconds sends it.
